say:16:1024103016:0.text: But as long as Bradduck is brought back to me, I'll offer all that I have.
say:16:1024103016:0.source_cn: 但只要布拉达克能回来，我不介意全部献出！

say:17:1024103018:0.text: Does that mean you will help...?

I guess we'll just keep doing what we're doing.
Tell us about the places you've been searching for Bradduck and any clues you've found.
say:18:1024103019:0.source_cn: 也算是熟能生巧。\n来吧，告诉我们，你之前去过哪些地方...

say:20:1024103021:0.source_cn: 有这些情报就足够了，小少爷。看我的吧。

say:28:1024103011:0.source_cn: 就让它在你的头上筑巢了？\n小少爷，对于一只鸭……飞禽...

say:3:1024105001:0.text: Young man, have you seen the duck on the notice board?
say:3:1024105001:0.source_cn: 小哥，你有见过告示板上那只黑鸭吗？

say:5:1024105003:0.text: Shh... Rowan. Let me do the talking.
say:5:1024105003:0.source_cn: 嘘，小少爷，问话就交给我吧。

say:6:1024105004:0.text: So you are looking for that duck!
say:6:1024105004:0.source_cn: 原来是你们在找那只鸭子！

say:7:1024105005:0.text: That duck has been hanging around my barn! When I first saw it, it was quacking and mocking me!
say:7:1024105005:0.source_cn: 就是它，几天前在我家的谷仓乱转！看到它的时候，它竟然还...

say:8:1024105006:0.text: A duck mocking ME! Ducks around here wouldn't be eating happy if it weren't for the grain that I grow!
say:8:1024105006:0.source_cn: 一只鸭子——嘲笑我？！它们吃的谷物还是我种出来的呢！！

say:9:1024105007:0.text: Umm... thanks for your information. Here's some compensation for the emotional damage!
say:9:1024105007:0.source_cn: 呃，谢谢您提供情报，这是给您的精神损失补偿！

say:0:1024106001:0.text: Why would Bradduck go to someone else's barn?
say:0:1024106001:0.source_cn: 布拉达克一世怎么会去别人的谷仓呢？

say:1:1024106002:0.text: Did he not like the oat milk and fruit porridge?
say:1:1024106002:0.source_cn: 是我给它准备的燕麦牛奶水果粥不合适吗？

say:2:1024106003:0.text: ...This duck eats better than me, Rowan.
say:2:1024106003:0.source_cn: ……它已经吃得比我还好了，小少爷。

say:2:1024107001:0.text: Please, my fine lady, do you have any information about this duck?
say:2:1024107001:0.source_cn: 这位优雅端庄的小姐，您能告诉我一些关于黑鸭的可贵情报吗？

say:3:1024107002:0.text: Oh, what a nice young man!

say:4:1024107003:0.text: That bloody—*cough*—strange duck has been walking outside my geese pen.
say:4:1024107003:0.source_cn: 那只该死的——咳嗯，奇怪的黑鸭子，总是在我的鹅圈外踱步。

say:5:1024107004:0.text: Last night, it quacked at the geese that I worked so hard to raise, and they spread their wings and flew away!
say:5:1024107004:0.source_cn: 昨天晚上，它对着鹅群叫了几声，然后我含辛茹苦养大的白鹅...

say:6:1024107005:0.text: Not just me. <style="highlight">People from the Mithril Consortium</style> also saw it!

say:7:1024107006:0.text: I am terribly sorry. Please kindly take this as compensation from the Mithril Consortium!
say:7:1024107006:0.source_cn: 真是对不起，秘银商会一定会赔偿您的损失，请笑纳！

say:8:1024107007:0.text: Speaking of which, where is your geese pen—I mean, your residence located?
say:8:1024107007:0.source_cn: 那么，您的鹅圈——不，您的府邸，在哪里呢？

say:9:1024107008:0.text: My house is just west of Holistone.

say:10:1024107009:0.text: So, young man, where do you live? Now that you know where I live, maybe we can stay in touch.
say:10:1024107009:0.source_cn: 话说小哥，你住哪里？我都把住址告诉你了，咱们以后可以多...

say:11:1024107010:0.text: Umm... Thank you for letting us know, my lady. I am currently busy with a task. I will visit another time.
say:11:1024107010:0.source_cn: ——感谢小姐垂青，我还有事要忙，之后一定！

say:1:1024108002:0.text: With your skills, you can sell anything! You gotta teach me!
say:1:1024108002:0.source_cn: 要是有你的话术，怎么会愁东西卖不出去？教教我！

say:2:1024108003:0.text: Stop that. I just needed to get the intel.
say:2:1024108003:0.source_cn: 饶了我吧，两位，都是为了打探情报啊。

say:5:1024109002:0.text: You're looking for that guy that likes to quack, right?
say:5:1024109002:0.source_cn: 哦，你们！你们就是找那只黑嘎嘎的人，对不对！

say:7:1024109004:0.text: Enfield's been looking for him. I just saw him running towards the Mithril Consortium. Maybe he's found him already?
say:7:1024109004:0.source_cn: 恩菲尔德一直在找它，刚才我看见他往秘银商会的方向跑过去...

say:8:1024109005:0.text: Huh? Enfield is helping me look for Bradduck too?
say:8:1024109005:0.source_cn: 咦，恩菲尔德也在帮我找布拉达克？

choice_prompt:9:1024109005.text: Huh? Enfield is helping me look for Bradduck too?
choice_prompt:9:1024109005.source_cn: 咦，恩菲尔德也在帮我找布拉达克？

say:10:1024109006:0.text: He's one of our clerks at the Mithril Consortium, but he should have nothing to do with Bradduck...
say:10:1024109006:0.source_cn: 是我们秘银商会的书记员，不过他和布拉达克应该没有关系才对……
say:10:1024109006:0.male: He's one of our clerks at the Mithril Consortium, but he should have nothing to do with Bradduck...
say:10:1024109006:0.female: He's one of our clerks at the Mithril Consortium, but he should have nothing to do with Bradduck...

say:11:1024109007:0.text: Thanks for telling me. Here's a token of my gratitude.
say:11:1024109007:0.source_cn: 谢谢你告诉我这么多，这是——呃，感谢费！

say:0:1024110001:0.text:
This is costing me a lot...
But Bradduck is worth it!
say:0:1024110001:0.source_cn: 真是一笔不小的开销……\n但为了布拉达克，一切都值得！

say:1:1024110002:0.text: Are you sure he's worth it?
say:1:1024110002:0.source_cn: 它真的值得你如此破费？

say:2:1024110003:0.text:
Bradduck is my best friend!
How can money buy friendship?
say:2:1024110003:0.source_cn: 布拉达克是我宝贵的伙伴！\n钱怎么能买来友谊和陪伴呢？

say:4:1024110005:0.text: You'll understand when you're an adult, Rowan.
say:4:1024110005:0.source_cn: 不过那是大人的世界，小少爷，你现在如此坚信就好。

say:1:1024115002:0.source_cn: 布拉达克一世！你原来在那儿！！

say:1:1024117002:0.text: I see feathers. Let's go that way!
say:1:1024117002:0.source_cn: 地上有留下的羽毛！它往那边去了！

say:0:1024118001:0.text: Bradduck flew out of town. Let's follow!
say:0:1024118001:0.source_cn: 它往镇外飞了，我们跟上！

say:1:1024118002:0.text: Why don't you want to come home with me...?
say:1:1024118002:0.source_cn: 布拉达克，为什么不愿意跟我回家……？

say:1:1024119002:0.text: Quiet! This is a bandit camp!
say:1:1024119002:0.source_cn: 别出声！这是个盗匪营地！

say:3:1024121001:0.text: Bradduck! Are you alright? Are you hurt? Did those barbarians ruffle your feathers?
say:3:1024121001:0.source_cn: 布拉达克！你没事吧？！有没有受伤，那些野蛮人有没有弄脏...

say:5:1024121003:0.text: I didn't expect to get rid of a bunch of bandits along the way.
say:5:1024121003:0.source_cn: 想不到在找它的途中，居然能顺便解决一伙盗匪。

say:6:1024121004:0.text: Hey duck, did you lead us here on purpose?
say:6:1024121004:0.source_cn: 我说……小家伙，难道你是故意引我们过来的？

say:1:1024122002:0.text:
...What happened, Bradduck?
Is something over there?
say:1:1024122002:0.source_cn: ……怎么了，布拉达克？\n那边有什么东西吗？

say:9:1024124005:1.text: ... Do they actually understand each other?

say:10:1024124006:1.text: They are actually talking to each other.
say:10:1024124006:1.source_cn: 布拉达克一世和鸭子，在对话。

choice_prompt:11:1024124006.text: They are actually talking to each other.
choice_prompt:11:1024124006.source_cn: 布拉达克一世和鸭子，在对话。

say:12:1024124007:1.text: Legend mentions the Aix laying golden eggs, but Master Rowan has never seen this happen.
say:12:1024124007:1.source_cn: 说是能产金蛋，但小少爷并没见过。

say:13:1024124008:1.source_cn: 所以它能不能生金蛋还是个未知数……

choice_prompt:14:1024124008.source_cn: 所以它能不能生金蛋还是个未知数……

say:15:1024124009:1.source_cn: 那么，我要冒昧问一个问题了。

say:16:1024124010:1.text: ...What's the difference between Bradduck and this other duck?

say:7:1024113004:0.text: I-I didn't mean it! I know how much Bradduck means to you! I-I had no choice...!
say:7:1024113004:0.source_cn: 我、我不是故意的！我知道布拉达克是您的爱宠，我只是，那...

say:8:1024113005:0.text: Well... Enfield, we can talk about this later...
say:8:1024113005:0.source_cn: 呃……恩菲尔德，发生了什么暂且不提……

say:9:1024113006:0.text: That's not Bradduck. Just an ordinary duck.
say:9:1024113006:0.source_cn: 这不是布拉达克，只是一只普通的黑鸭。

say:11:1024113008:0.text: How can this be? Look at its smooth feathers, the round tail, and its arrogant expression. No duck, but your Bradduck holds such elegance!
say:11:1024113008:0.source_cn: 怎么可能？！这油光水滑的羽毛，丰满圆润的尾巴，高傲多变...

say:14:1024113010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I thought you would remember Bradduck!
say:14:1024113010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I thought you would remember Bradduck!
say:14:1024113010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I thought you would remember Bradduck!

say:15:1024113011:0.text: Bradduck has a harmless round beak, and his webbed feet are as tender as freshwater lilies.
say:15:1024113011:0.source_cn: 布拉达克的喙圆润无害，双蹼也柔嫩得像初生的睡莲叶。
say:15:1024113011:0.male: Bradduck has a harmless round beak, and his webbed feet are as tender as freshwater lilies.
say:15:1024113011:0.female: Bradduck has a harmless round beak, and his webbed feet are as tender as freshwater lilies.

say:17:1024113013:0.text: ... His eyes are noble, gentle, and all-knowing. He is beyond a common duck!
say:17:1024113013:0.source_cn: 它有高贵、柔和，超脱于寻常兽类，洞悉一切的阔达眼神！
